title: Open a file in Xcode editor
summary: Use the `xed` command to open one or more files directly in the Xcode editor from the Terminal. This is useful if you have Xcode installed and want to edit code or text files without navigating through the Xcode interface.

steps.explain: Run the `xed` command followed by the path to the file you want to edit. Xcode will launch and open the file.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file you want to open in Xcode.

alternatives.explain: Open a file and jump directly to a specific line number.

placeholders.name: LINE_NUMBER
placeholders.description: The line number to jump to.

alternatives.explain: Open a file, creating it if it does not exist.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file to open or create.
